sections.body: Tablets and phones can be fun! 📱
Before you tap something new, ask a grown-up. 🙋
If something makes you scared or sad, tell a grown-up right away. 💛
Screens need a rest too. When time is up, we stop and play! ⚽
Keep devices in shared spaces and use them together at this age. Praise your child every time they come to you, so telling you becomes a habit.

quiz.q: A new game pops up on the tablet. What do you do?
hints: Is this game new or one you know?
Who helps you decide what is safe?
When you want to cross the road, you hold a grown-up's hand. New things on a screen are the same.

quiz.q: Screen time is over. What do you do?
hints: What happens when the timer rings?
Screens need a rest, and so do your eyes.
When bath time is over, we get out of the bath. When screen time is over…?
